skill.name: Copywriting
skill.description: Writes persuasive marketing copy across formats, covering tone, structure, clarity, and the discipline of selling benefits rather than features.
skill.summary: Sell benefits via the so-what ladder (3-5 levels to a felt need); adjectives are unquantified features, swap for a number. Headlines get ~5x the body's readers: write 5-10, lead with specifics. Grade 6-8, edit by ear, final often 40-60% shorter. One CTA per page: warm above the fold, cold after the argument. A/B tests need ~100+ conversions/variant; 10-30% lift is strong, 2-3x is noise.
